docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The sayings of the fourteenth-century Kashmiri Śaiva yoginī Lalleśvarī, the first poet of Kashmiri, in Temple’s English translation with the notes of her commentators.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned and hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Word Of Lalla The Prophettess · Temple Richard Carnac · 1920, 314 scanned pages. Published at Cambridge by 1924; Lal Ded lived in the fourteenth century and her translator Richard Carnac Temple died 1931; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
